title: New research shows that policies, visa prospects, and AI are increasingly on the minds of international students choosing where to study
description:
New IDP Emerging Futures research reminds us that policies intended to redress only select problems and/or institutions in international education often have much broader consequences. When policies are announced too frequently – and/or with too little industry consultation or forewarning – they can hobble the recruitment efforts of even the highest quality institutions operating ethically…
